text: しつれんを　いやす　ために　おけいこ　がんばって　いたら　つよく　なったわ！

structure.jp: しつれんを　いやす　ために
structure.en: in order to heal my broken heart

structure.jp: おけいこ　がんばって　いたら
structure.en: when I was working hard at practice

patterns.name: 〜ために
patterns.explanation: A verb followed by ために means 'in order to' do it. しつれんを　いやす　ために = 'in order to heal my broken heart'.

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.span: がんばって　いたら
patterns.explanation: The たら ending means 'when' that happened, often with a result you did not expect. Here it is on ていた, 'was doing'. がんばって　いたら = 'when I kept working hard, (I found that)'.

patterns.name: 〜くなる
patterns.explanation: An い-word changed to く plus なる means 'to become' that way. つよく　なった = 'became strong'.
